value.title: Croix-de-Feu
value.extract: The Croix-de-Feu (French: [kʁwa də fø], Cross of Fire) was a nationalist French league of the interwar period, led by Colonel François de la Rocque (1885–1946). After it was dissolved, as were all other leagues during the Popular Front period (1936–38), La Rocque established the Parti social français (PSF) to replace it.
